judgments.reason: The model_articulation explicitly describes paying the bid then receiving the three-coin commission; it does not articulate a mechanism where commission is applied before payment to allow overbidding, so the hypothesis is unarticulated and unsupported.

The model_articulation treats sealed bids as private until resolution and does not state that waiting reveals rivals' committed bid values before you commit, so the hypothesis is unarticulated and unsupported.
The transcript shows closure after all lots were sold and the model_articulation describes settlement after all three lots are sold; there is no articulated or observed early-settlement discrepancy.
The model_articulation states catalog items are not auction wins and gives no account of commissions applying to catalog purchases, so the hypothesis is unarticulated and unsupported.
